description: Composite provenance figure: ATG9A cytosolic motif scan, ortholog conservation vs AP-4 presence, and mu4-APP structural contacts
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import defaultdict
S=requests.Session()

# ---------- (a) ATG9A topology + motif scan ----------
d=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q7Z3C6.json",timeout=60).json()
seq=d['sequence']['value']; L=len(seq)
topo=[(f['location']['start']['value'],f['location']['end']['value'],f['description'])
      for f in d['features'] if f['type']=='Topological domain']
tm=[(f['location']['start']['value'],f['location']['end']['value'],f['type'])
    for f in d['features'] if f['type'] in ('Transmembrane','Intramembrane')]
diso=[(f['location']['start']['value'],f['location']['end']['value'])
      for f in d['features'] if f['type']=='Region' and f.get('description')=='Disordered']
cyto=[(s,e) for s,e,desc in topo if desc=='Cytoplasmic']
yx=[];
for s,e in cyto:
    for m in re.finditer(r'(?=(Y..[FILMV]))', seq[s-1:e]):
        st=s+m.start(); yx.append((st,m.group(1), bool(re.match(r'[DE]',seq[st+3:st+4]))))
dil=[(s+m.start(),m.group(1)) for s,e in cyto for m in re.finditer(r'(?=([DE]...L[LIM]))',seq[s-1:e])]

# ---------- (b) ortholog conservation ----------
def search(q,size=5):
    r=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
            params={"query":q,"size":size,"fields":"accession,length,sequence","format":"json"},timeout=60)
    return r.json()["results"]
spec=[("H. sapiens ATG9A","gene_exact:ATG9A AND organism_id:9606 AND reviewed:true",True),
      ("M. musculus Atg9a","gene_exact:Atg9a AND organism_id:10090 AND reviewed:true",True),
      ("R. norvegicus Atg9a","gene_exact:Atg9a AND organism_id:10116",True),
      ("B. taurus ATG9A","gene_exact:ATG9A AND organism_id:9913",True),
      ("G. gallus ATG9A","gene_exact:ATG9A AND organism_id:9031",True),
      ("X. tropicalis atg9a","gene_exact:atg9a AND organism_id:8364",True),
      ("D. rerio atg9a","gene_exact:atg9a AND organism_id:7955",True),
      ("H. sapiens ATG9B","gene_exact:ATG9B AND organism_id:9606 AND reviewed:true",True),
      ("D. melanogaster Atg9","gene_exact:Atg9 AND organism_id:7227",False),
      ("C. elegans atg-9","gene_exact:atg-9 AND organism_id:6239",False),
      ("A. thaliana ATG9","gene_exact:ATG9 AND organism_id:3702",False),
      ("S. cerevisiae ATG9","gene_exact:ATG9 AND organism_id:559292 AND reviewed:true",False),
      ("S. pombe atg9","gene_exact:atg9 AND organism_id:284812",False)]
orows=[]
for lab,q,ap4 in spec:
    h=max(search(q),key=lambda x:x["sequence"]["length"]); s=h["sequence"]["value"]
    m=re.search(r'Y..[FILMVWY][DE]', s[:60])
    m2=re.search(r'Y..[FILMV]', s[:60])
    orows.append(dict(label=lab, acc=h["primaryAccession"], ap4=("yes" if ap4 and "ATG9B" not in lab else ("yes" if ap4 else "no")),
                      nterm=s[:16], sig=(m.group(0) if m else ""), pos=(m.start()+1 if m else None),
                      yxphi=(m2.group(0) if m2 else "")))
O=pd.DataFrame(orows)
O.loc[O.label=="H. sapiens ATG9B","ap4"]="yes"
O["ap4_in_species"]=["yes"]*8+["no"]*5
O.to_csv("atg9_conservation_table.csv",index=False)

# ---------- (c) 3L81 contacts ----------
pdb=S.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/3L81.pdb",timeout=60).text
at=[dict(ch=l[21],resi=int(l[22:26]),resn=l[17:20].strip(),xyz=(float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])))
    for l in pdb.splitlines() if l.startswith("ATOM")]
A=pd.DataFrame(at); P=A[A.ch=="B"]; M=A[A.ch=="A"]
D=np.linalg.norm(np.array(P.xyz.tolist())[:,None,:]-np.array(M.xyz.tolist())[None,:,:],axis=2)
cnt=defaultdict(int)
for a,_ in zip(*np.where(D<4.5)): cnt[(P.iloc[a].resi,P.iloc[a].resn)]+=1
cdf=pd.DataFrame([dict(resi=k[0],resn=k[1],n=v) for k,v in cnt.items()]).sort_values("resi")

# ================= FIGURE =================
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,11))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,2,height_ratios=[1,1.25,1.1],hspace=0.55,wspace=0.28)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1,-0.12),L,0.24,color="#d9d9d9"))
for s,e,desc in topo:
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((s,-0.12),e-s+1,0.24,color="#9ecae1" if desc=="Cytoplasmic" else "#fdbf6f"))
for s,e,t in tm:
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((s,-0.18),e-s+1,0.36,color="#525252"))
for s,e in diso:
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((s,0.20),e-s+1,0.08,color="#6a51a3"))
for st,pep,acid in yx:
    col="#d7301f" if acid else "#737373"
    ax.plot([st],[0.42],marker="v",color=col,ms=11 if acid else 7)
    ax.text(st,0.50,f"{pep}\n{st}",ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=8,color=col,
            fontweight="bold" if acid else "normal")
for st,pep in dil:
    ax.plot([st],[-0.40],marker="^",color="#2171b5",ms=7)
    ax.text(st,-0.56,f"{pep}\n{st}",ha="center",va="top",fontsize=8,color="#2171b5")
ax.set_xlim(-30,L+30); ax.set_ylim(-0.85,0.95); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("ATG9A residue (UniProt Q7Z3C6, 839 aa)")
ax.set_title("a  Motif scan of the 653 cytosolic residues of human ATG9A\n"
             "blue = cytosolic, orange = lumenal, dark grey = membrane-embedded, purple = disordered\n"
             "red triangles: YxxØ followed by Asp/Glu; grey: YxxØ only; blue triangles: [DE]xxxL[LI]",
             fontsize=10,loc="left")

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,:])
y=np.arange(len(O))[::-1]
colors=["#2171b5" if s else "#cccccc" for s in O.sig]
ax.barh(y,[1 if s else 0.02 for s in O.sig],color=colors,height=0.6)
for yy,(_,r) in zip(y,O.iterrows()):
    ax.text(1.03,yy,f"{r.nterm}",fontsize=9,family="monospace",va="center")
    ax.text(-0.02,yy,r.label,fontsize=9,ha="right",va="center")
    ax.text(1.60,yy,("YxxØ+acid: "+r.sig+f" @{r.pos}") if r.sig else ("YxxØ: "+r.yxphi if r.yxphi else "none"),
            fontsize=8.5,va="center",color="#2171b5" if r.sig else "#777777")
    ax.text(2.35,yy,f"AP-4 in genome: {r.ap4_in_species}",fontsize=8.5,va="center",
            color="#1a9850" if r.ap4_in_species=="yes" else "#d73027")
ax.set_xlim(-0.75,2.9); ax.set_ylim(-1,len(O)); ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("b  The YQRLE signal (residues 8-12) is present in every vertebrate ATG9A tested\n"
             "and absent from ATG9B and from ATG9 of lineages that lack AP-4",fontsize=10,loc="left")

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,0])
lab=[f"{r.resn[0]}{r.resn[1:].lower()}{r.resi}" for _,r in cdf.iterrows()]
ax.bar(range(len(cdf)),cdf.n,color=["#d7301f" if r.resi in (687,690,691) else "#969696" for _,r in cdf.iterrows()])
ax.set_xticks(range(len(cdf))); ax.set_xticklabels(lab,rotation=45,ha="right",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("atom pairs < 4.5 A")
ax.set_title("c  APP peptide burial on mu4 CTD (PDB 3L81, 1.6 A)",fontsize=10,loc="left")

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,1]); ax.axis("off")
rowsT=[["APP position","Y687","K688","F689","F690","E691"],
       ["mu4 contacts (<4.5 A)","23","19","24","91","13"],
       ["ATG9A equivalent","Y8","Q9","R10","L11","E12"],
       ["Ala scan vs AP-4 (PMID 29180427)","abolished","abolished","no effect","abolished","abolished"]]
t=ax.table(cellText=[r[1:] for r in rowsT],rowLabels=[r[0] for r in rowsT],
           colLabels=["+0","+1","+2","+3","+4"],loc="center",cellLoc="center")
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(8.5); t.scale(1,1.7)
ax.set_title("d  Register alignment of ATG9A YQRLE onto the APP YKFFE site",fontsize=10,loc="left")
plt.show()
print(O.to_string(index=False))
